description: Generates a complete, tested multi-page web application as a Simulator.Company Smart Form from a set of EXISTING Corezoid processes plus a description of the desired product. Use when the user has a working Corezoid backend (a folder or list of process ids) and wants it turned into a usable web app / site / portal / mini-app — not when they want to edit one page or one process. This skill owns the end-to-end pipeline: pull every process, derive its real input/output contract from its `api_rpc_reply` nodes, design a page map that uses ALL of the processes, build the Smart Form, generate the Corezoid middleware process that bridges the form to those processes via `api_rpc`, bind it, then verify the whole thing end-to-end and self-repair. It delegates page authoring to `simulator-smart-forms`, backend briefs to `simulator-smart-forms-logic`, styling to `simulator-styles`, and page-driving to `simulator-smart-forms-runtime`.
